camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateJob --region cn-hangzhou --RolloutConfig '{"maximumPerMinute":1000}' --TimeoutConfig '{"inProgressTimeoutInMinutes":60}' --Description jobDescription --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --JobId XUbmsMHmkqv0PiAG0000010001
description_en: Updates the job configuration of a task
description_zh: 调用该接口更新任务下作业配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-job --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --description jobDescription --timeout-config inProgressTimeoutInMinutes=60 --rollout-config maximumPerMinute=1000 --job-id XUbmsMHmkqv0PiAG0000010001 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the task. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述信息。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for job execution in the task.

For more information, see the "TimeoutConfig definition" section below
parameters.help_zh:
任务下作业执行的超时时间。

更多信息，请参见下文“TimeoutConfig定义”
parameters.name: timeout_config

parameters.help_en: The number of jobs pushed per minute in the task. Valid values: 50 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 任务下每分钟推送的作业数量。取值范围为50~1000
parameters.name: rollout_config

parameters.help_en: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task

parameters.name: job_id
